page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 instance belonging to the High Clock Speed server family, virtualized via KVM. The instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 128.0 GB, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware infrastructure for this instance excludes local storage volumes, necessitating remote block storage integration for persistent filesystems. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or discrete GPU accelerators.

By delivering elevated clock frequencies alongside an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, the ecs.hfr9i.4xlarge supports compute tasks that simultaneously demand high single-core capability and significant memory space. It is engineered for workloads such as in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes, memory-heavy data pipelines, and relational database management systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 server instance within the High Clock Speed family, deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The configuration omits local disk storage, relying on external network-attached storage options, and provides a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without included complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Lacking hardware graphics acceleration, this instance is architected for CPU-bound tasks demanding substantial RAM capacity. The combination of elevated clock speed and high memory density makes this profile well matched for workloads such as in-memory databases, data processing pipelines, caching layers, and enterprise transactional backends.
